NewsArticle.Title: Wedding Mishap
NewsArticle.Content:
Bella the Barmaid of the Tulsi Brew in Piet writes: I cannot believe what my eyes have just seen. Not even a day away from the wedding of two of the Anaman Pact members, and one was kidnapped right before my eyes! Hollie was to marry Rookerin this eve, but as she sat in the Tulsi Brew, a figure passed before her. "Hollie, why have you forsaken me? There are none better then I." I heard the man before her say. He was draped in dark robes, and the prayer necklace of Sgrios about his neck. I had seen him long before, he was one of Hollie's suitors that she utterly detested. "I, do not love you! Leave me be, please." Hollie quickly retorted. I saw anger build up in the Sgrios follower's eyes as he gripped her by the arm and pulled her to her feet. If only I had just a bit of the Aisling spark inside of me, I would have jumped over the counter and gave that man a good smack! Sadly, all I could do was watch as he pulled her outside of the tavern, yelling, "If I can't have you, no one will!" A note was left outside the tavern, written with a crazed man's writing. It was her suitor, and he spoke of sacrificing her to his God deep inside the Piet Crypts..Aislings! Please, help save Hollie from the crazed man..there is little time before her wedding. Will you Aislings save her in time? Bella. (( Event begins 99.12.14, 7 p.m. PST. Wedding begins at 9 p.m. PST at the Mileth Chapel.
))
